news.title: Cameron Boozer scores 29 and Grizzlies hand the Wizards an 8th straight loss, 136-120

news.text: The Rockets scored a season-high 147 points against the Wizards on Sunday in their win, during which they also held Trae Young scoreless for the first time in his NBA career.

news.text: — Amen Thompson scored 26 points and Kevin Durant added 25 to help the Houston Rockets rout the Washington Wizards 147-119 on Sunday night for their fourth straight win.
